title: Bake-off: short discharge summary (pneumonia)

pages.text:
SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT - FAKE DATA ONLY
Sampletown General Hospital - Discharge Summary

Patient name: Avery Example
Born: April 17, 1961
Visit number: V-2026-554433
Admitted: 2026-10-01     Discharged: 2026-10-05

Next of kin: Jordan Example (husband), 613-555-0188
Emergency contact: Sam Testperson, sam.testperson@example.net
Mailing address: PO Box 4410, Sampletown, Ontario K9Z 9Z9

Course: Admitted with community-acquired pneumonia. Treated with ceftriaxone 1 g IV daily,
then amoxicillin 1 g PO three times daily for 5 days. Oxygen weaned by day 3.
Sam will drive her home.

Follow-up: Family doctor, Dr. Casey Placeholder, within 1 week. Book at the
Maplewood Family Health Team, (613) 555-0142.

Electronically signed by: Dr. Taylor Notreal, MD

approved_statements: She was admitted with community-acquired pneumonia.
